programme.title: SkywatchTV - The War Of The Watchers

• Why Genesis 6 is foundational to understanding the supernatural worldview of the Bible • The connection between the Watchers the Nephilim and spiritual warfare • Why Bashan Mount Hermon and Sodom play such important roles in biblical history • How Jesus confronted the powers of darkness in places associated with the ancient rebellion • Other insights from Derek Gilberts brand-new book War of the Watchers
If youve ever wanted to better understand the unseen realm described in Scripture this conversation is one you wont want to miss
